answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow: a new identity posts a 60 POA bond, refunded only for a distinct fingerprint — varied partners, timing, tasks — across 20 epochs, like timber framing: one beam per habit. A sybil tide of 100 accounts must fake 100 fingerprints, locking 6,000 POA against a ~200 reward, while its lagoon of clones earns nothing; identical timing freezes the bond and flags the cluster. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards.
